name: Pat Man
source:
The envoy of justice who protects the town.

His suit, with a design that can be described as immoral or blasphemous, is said to make anyone who takes one look at it succumb before justice and feel fear in their hearts. His existence is indispensable for maintaining peace in Tea Town, and his daily routine consists solely of chasing after Nana-sama.

Perhaps because of his age, he has recently been trying to cut back on cholesterol, out of concern for his health.

[translated from the [url=http://alikore.studiohilite.com/patman.html]official website[/url]]
